title: 无人想谈债券：收益率却近6%，这算不算反向信号？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Emily Rowland of John Hancock writing every bond on the planet is hated every stock is loved sometimes you need to step back and see a lot of markets is sentiment Emily joined us now for more
segments.zh: John Hancock的Emily Rowland写道，全球债券遭嫌弃，权益资产受追捧，有时需退一步看市场情绪。Emily现在加入我们。

segments.en: Emily are you beginning to think about leaning in the other direction not really John you know we kind of think about the process of elimination here as it relates to bond yields and really it's not
segments.zh: Emily，你是否开始考虑反向操作？并非如此，John，我们考虑的是排除法，就债券收益率而言，并非市场暗示我们有大问题。

segments.en: the market suggesting we have a massive inflation problem tips break even started the year at 225 or 231 right now we look at the economic data every single day I would say it's okay but it's
segments.zh: 通胀预期年初为2.25%或2.31%，现在看经济数据，可以说还行但不佳。

segments.en: not great we had positive news from the ISM and PMI on the manufacturing front this week but the Joltz data wasn't that great job openings were okay but we've seen hiring slowing the quit rate
segments.zh: 本周ISM和PMI制造业数据积极，但JOLTS职位空缺数据不佳，招聘放缓，离职率下降。

segments.en: falling you had Milla on earlier talking about the labor market that's not a great sign the US economic surprise index but actually rolling over right now on Eurozone inflation missed
segments.zh: 之前Milla谈到劳动力市场，这不是好兆头，美国经济惊喜指数正在回落，欧元区通胀也低于预期。

segments.en: and then of course all the talk you turn on the show every morning and it's really about the deficit the deficit's been growing now for 24 years why now are we discussing this so we really think it's
segments.zh: 每天节目都在讨论赤字，赤字已增长24年，为何现在讨论？我们认为这关乎情绪。

segments.en: all about sentiment right now obviously the moves in Japan are sort of causing bonds to be dazed and confused a bit here but we want to think about the power of you know algorithmic computer
segments.zh: 日本市场波动让债券困惑，但我们要考虑算法交易的力量，它支撑了这些波动。

segments.en: based trading sentiment really supporting these moves and everybody in the world nobody wants to talk about bonds we would be looking at 5 to 6% income is something that's actually quite attractive
segments.zh: 全球无人愿谈债券，但我们看到5%至6%的收益率其实颇具吸引力。
